authority.grant_scope_requested: Standing Runtime 007: exactly Runtime 006 (target, session/pacing/budgets, reconnect/reclaim, pages, receive-only ButtonProbe, raw-send/target prohibitions) re-bound to the first-frame-spacing Host build. Adding or changing a page changes code/asset hashes and needs a fresh reviewed revision and grant.
authority.revocation: scripts/cutover_runtime_007.sh --rollback restores the Runtime 006 Host, Studio, local policies and source, then restarts the service

behavior.collector_ownership: product runtime collects while connected and while backing off; standalone collector timer is transactionally disabled and restored on uninstall

build.host_note: Host re-bind only: the candidate Host sends every session's FIRST frame with the proven 10 ms packet spacing (first-frame IMAGE_RX_RECV_TIMEOUT: 5/19 streaming_ack_clock opens vs 0/199 activity opens, captures/OPENDITOO-STREAMING-FIRST-FRAME-TIMEOUT-ANALYSIS-2026-09-10.json); later frames keep the profile spacing. Build is path-independent (PathMap).

description: Persistent plug-and-play MCP activity dashboard for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus; Runtime 002 adds telemetry-only live session observability. Runtime 003 re-binds the policy to the session-profile Host build. Runtime 004 re-binds the policy to the Host build with a separate streaming-profile ceiling. Runtime 006 adds physical-button pagination: the Ditoo's left/right arrows page through a wrap-around list (dashboard first), a short lever pull runs the current page's own action, input from the receive-only ButtonProbe (SMTC, mirror status) run as a child of the product. Runtime 007: Host re-bind only: the candidate Host sends every session's FIRST frame with the proven 10 ms packet spacing (first-frame IMAGE_RX_RECV_TIMEOUT: 5/19 streaming_ack_clock opens vs 0/199 activity opens, captures/OPENDITOO-STREAMING-FIRST-FRAME-TIMEOUT-ANALYSIS-2026-09-10.json); later frames keep the profile spacing. Build is path-independent (PathMap).

install.startup_boundary: Windows user logon / StartWhenAvailable; WSL is user-scoped, so this is the reliable Windows startup boundary

broker.lifetime: child of the product runtime; ends with it (webcam suspend, uninstall, stop); restarted at most every 5 s if it dies
broker.media_keys: while running, Windows media keys (Prev/Next/Play/Pause) page the Ditoo; YouTube contention PASS (BTN-8a); Spotify untested

navigation.lever_candidate: current page's lever action; long holds are never mapped (BTN-7)

session.renewal: fresh unique Host session after lifetime/budget; displayed frame persists across brief socket rollover
